OAuth URL Builder

Build OAuth 2.0 authorization URLs for Google, GitHub, Microsoft, Discord or a custom provider.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose the provider (or Custom for your own endpoint).
  2. Enter client ID, redirect URI and scopes.
  3. Optionally generate a random state value.
  4. Copy the authorization URL or download it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which providers are supported?

Google, GitHub, Microsoft (common endpoint) and Discord, plus a Custom option where you paste any authorization endpoint.

What scopes should I use?

Each provider preselects sensible defaults (e.g. openid email profile for Google). Adjust to the permissions your app needs.

What is the state parameter?

A random value your app checks on callback to prevent CSRF attacks. Use the Generate button for a cryptographically random one.

Does this complete the OAuth flow?

No — it builds the authorization URL you redirect users to. Your backend still exchanges the returned code for tokens.
